notes: Design is one half bridge with 2N devices; three identical legs form the 18.75 kW inverter.
SVM m=1.15 is user input. SPWM m=0.99 is a separate example, not equivalent output voltage; linear SPWM cannot use m=1.15.
Zero ripple and unity power factor assumed. Current is sinusoidal; integration resolves fundamental angle, not carrier ripple.
Switching energy is an analytical placeholder at 125 C, with constant overlap times independent of N. Existing single-device DPT does not validate parallel operation.
TIM 0.5mm / 17.8W/mK / 15mm2 and plate 0.3K/W per halfbridge are assumptions. Full package contact area is idealized; contact and spreading need verification.
Strict centered PWM pulse screen; pulse dropping, clamping and overmodulation are not modeled.
Other losses zero pending copper, capacitor, auxiliary and driver-quiescent characterization. Efficiency is a preliminary upper estimate.
